reviews.comment:
Restaurante ubicado en Cazalla, plena sierra norte de Sevilla, con unas vistas excelentes y una terraza aun mejor. Se respira tranquilidad, y el servicio es muy amable y eficiente.
La comida es fenomenal con platos fuera de lo común y de alta calidad. Sorprende la comida italiana combinada con la carne de la sierra. Ideal para comer pese al COVID gracias a la amplitud del restaurante y la terraza. De obligada visita si se viene a Cazalla de la sierra.

(Translated by Google)
This restaurant, located in Cazalla, in the heart of the Sierra Norte mountains of Seville, boasts excellent views and an even better terrace. A tranquil atmosphere pervades the place, and the service is very friendly and efficient.

The food is phenomenal, with unique and high-quality dishes. The combination of Italian cuisine with local mountain meats is a delightful surprise. Thanks to the restaurant's spaciousness and terrace, it's an ideal place to dine despite the COVID restrictions. A must-visit if you're in Cazalla de la Sierra.
reviews.name: anon/97c4f89295496153
